goal: Review Entity Framework Core code for query shape, change tracking, migrations, transactions and raw SQL.
use: Review Entity Framework Core code for query shape, change tracking, migrations, transactions and raw SQL. Use when data access code or migrations change.

steps.note: Read the data access. Open the DbContext, the entity configuration and the migration history.
Check query shape. Flag queries that load whole tables, lazy loading inside loops, and client-side evaluation that should run in the database.
Check tracking. Read-only queries should use no-tracking.
Check migrations. Flag migrations that drop columns, change types or lock large tables without a plan.
Check transactions and raw SQL. Multi-step changes need a transaction.
Report. List each finding with its file and line, severity and the fix.

protocol.title: Read the data access
protocol.text: Open the DbContext, the entity configuration and the migration history.

protocol.text: Flag queries that load whole tables, lazy loading inside loops, and client-side evaluation that should run in the database.

protocol.title: Check tracking
protocol.text: Read-only queries should use no-tracking. Flag tracked entities returned to clients.

protocol.title: Check migrations
protocol.text: Flag migrations that drop columns, change types or lock large tables without a plan.

protocol.title: Check transactions and raw SQL
protocol.text: Multi-step changes need a transaction. Flag raw SQL built from strings.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: List each finding with its file and line, severity and the fix. Mark which findings need the query plan to confirm.
